name: fractional-cfo-consulting-medium-suite
known_facts: Cash flow forecasting (13-week rolling) is the #1 value-add for early-stage companies
Fractional CFO should spend no more than 20% of time on transaction processing
Board reporting should be concise -- 5-page max with P&L, cash flow, KPIs, risks
For PE-backed companies, lender covenant monitoring is table stakes
